Ava Thompson: Hi team — quick Notion question. I can view the 'Engineer Onboarding Checklist' but it's read-only. I want to duplicate it for my personal ramp notes and give my manager access. Who should I ask for edit rights?

devex: Welcome Ava! For one-off duplicates you don't need workspace edit rights. Steps: 1) Open the page -> 8 (•••) -> Duplicate. 2) Move duplicate to 'My workspace' or the Onboarding space. If you need to change the canonical checklist, request page-level Editor from @devex with the page URL and justification.

Ava Thompson: Thanks. If I duplicate, will the database properties (Owner, Status, Week) copy over? I want to pre-populate Week 1 items.

Noah Rivera: Yes — database properties are preserved on duplicate. If you want Week to default to '1', add a template row inside the duplicated DB or edit the duplicated view and set a default for that property.

docs-bot: Tip: to set a default inside a database template -> Open DB -> New -> 
```
Click on the dropdown next to + New -> Configure template -> Set fields
```
This will apply when users create a new row using that template.

Ava Thompson: Great. Two more quicks: (1) I want my manager to see the ramp notes in our team space, not just my workspace. How to share safely? (2) Is there a canonical naming convention?

Priya Desai: For sharing: Move the duplicated page into the Team > Eng > Onboarding space and set Page Permissions -> Invite Manager as Editor or Commenter depending on who should edit. For visibility, add page property "Visibility" with values: Private / Team / Public.

devex: Naming convention: please use "Onboard - <First Last> - <Team> - <CohortMonthYear>" for cohort pages. Example: `Onboard - Ava Thompson - Eng - Jun2026`. This helps automation that sweeps old pages.

Ava Thompson: Perfect. I'll duplicate, set the Week defaults via template, move to Team Onboarding, and DM @devex with the page URL to add my manager as Editor. Thanks! :raised_hands:
